name: aether-bcs-helper
description: BCS helper: Phase 1 (link) opens a classic-Bluetooth RFCOMM link; the sidecar writes only allowlisted auth frames. Phase 2 (codec) is the pure Huawei packet codec. Phase 3 (trust/auth) is the HiChain state machine; the key is held in memory only and never logged or sent.
comment: No dependencies on purpose: Node >= 22.6 strips TypeScript types itself, so the transport and its tests run with no install step. The Python side is standard library only.

scripts.test:codec: node --test test/huaweiCrc16.test.ts test/huaweiVarInt.test.ts test/huaweiTlv.test.ts test/huaweiFrame.test.ts test/huaweiStream.test.ts test/huaweiRequests.test.ts
